**As a** multi-location owner in ABC Insights

**I want** to reports that contain key KPIs by location that I can customize by time and schedule for email share

**so that I** can more efficiently operate my business and make more informed business decisions.

* Filters at top of the reports for location and date period. (note date period on State of the Business is monthly only where we want more flexibility on the paginated report)
* Reports should be allowed to be 'scheduled' by default.
